title: Seeing Allred

text.lead: Seeing Allred is a 2018 documentary film directed by Roberta Grossman and Sophie Sartain, following women's rights attorney Gloria Allred as she takes on cases of sexual assault allegations concerning some of the most famous people in politics and business. The film was released by Netflix on February 9, 2018.
text.plot: Seeing Allred provides a biographical portrait of one of the most public women's rights attorneys, Gloria Allred, through archival footage and interviews with both her supporters and critics.
text.cast:
- Gloria Allred
- Lisa Bloom
- Bill Cosby
- Roy Moore
- Gloria Steinem
